name: Passkey
description: Passkeys allow users to authenticate without a password.

user_id.label: User
user_id.description: User who owns this authentication factor.
user_id.help: Links the authentication factor to a user account.

type.label: Type
type.help: Identifies the technical mechanism used by the factor.

label.label: Label
label.help: Helps the user distinguish several passkeys.

status.label: Status
status.help: Controls whether the passkey can currently be used for authentication.

confirmed_at.label: Confirmed at
confirmed_at.description: Date and time when the passkey was confirmed.
confirmed_at.help: Empty until the passkey has been validated and activated.

last_used_at.label: Last used at
last_used_at.description: Date and time when the passkey was last used.
last_used_at.help: Tracks the latest successful authentication using this passkey.

revoked_at.label: Revoked at
revoked_at.description: Date and time when the passkey was revoked.
revoked_at.help: Empty until the passkey is permanently revoked.

revoked_reason.label: Revocation reason
revoked_reason.description: Reason why the passkey was revoked.
revoked_reason.help: Stores an optional explanation for audit or support purposes.

credential_id.label: Credential ID
credential_id.help: The credential is stored as a hexadecimal string.

credential_public_key.label: Public key
credential_public_key.help: The public key is created by the authenticator.

signature_counter.label: Signature counter
signature_counter.help: Used to detect replay attacks and cloned keys.

fmt.label: Format
fmt.description: Attestation format used by the authenticator.
fmt.help: Possible values include tpm, packed, fido-u2f, android-key and none.
